prompt: Which Greek pole vaulter who participated in the 2020 Summer Olympics in Tokyo also won gold at the 2015 IAAF Diamond League?
answer: The Greek pole vaulter was **Nikoleta (Nicole) Kyriakopoulou**. She placed eighth at the Tokyo 2020 Olympics and won the **2015 IAAF Diamond League pole-vault title**.
